capabilities: Render image galleries from embedded images in a code block
Display images in a full-screen viewer with zoom and pan
Navigate galleries with keyboard arrows or mobile swipe gestures
Customize grid columns, gaps and the code block keyword
Merge selected images into a gallery with a Templater script
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The author found other gallery plugins build galleries from a folder of images, which does not work in knowledge bases without folder-based organization; this one builds galleries from attachments already in the note.
problem: Obsidian shows embedded images as standalone blocks with no way to group them into a gallery or view them enlarged with zoom and navigation.

relations.evidence: Select all the images you wish to add to the gallery and run the Templater script

summary: Image gallery plugin that turns code blocks listing embedded images into responsive grids, with a full-screen viewer supporting zoom, pan and swipe.
